name: di-promptu-biblioteka
description: DI Promptų Biblioteka – statinė HTML platforma + EN paid PDF fulfillment (CMO Kit)

scripts.build: node scripts/export-favicons.js && node scripts/generate-og.js && node scripts/build-locale-pages.js && node scripts/vercel-export-public.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node tests/structure.test.js && node tests/cmo-prompt-registry.test.js && node tests/design-system-smoke.test.js && node tests/a11y-smoke.test.js && node tests/fulfillment-config.test.js && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:js
scripts.test:smoke: start-server-and-test "npx serve public -l 3000" http://127.0.0.1:3000/ "npx playwright test tests/e2e/smoke.spec.js"
scripts.test:e2e: start-server-and-test "npx serve public -l 3000" http://127.0.0.1:3000/ "npx playwright test tests/e2e/"
scripts.test:a11y: start-server-and-test "npx serve public -l 3000" http://127.0.0.1:3000/ "npx pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3000/en/ --config .pa11yrc.json && npx pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3000/success.html?session_id=cs_test_FAKE --config .pa11yrc.json && npx pa11y http://127.0.0.1:3000/terms.html --config .pa11yrc.json"
scripts.lint:html: npx html-validate index.html lt/index.html lt/privatumas.html en/index.html en/privacy.html success.html terms.html coming-soon.html
